dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi! Do you need any help?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! duː juː ˈniːd ˈɛni ˈhɛlp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I want a necklace for my friend.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. aɪ ˈwɑːnt ə ˈnɛkləs fər maɪ ˈfrɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's beautiful. What's it made of?
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl. ˈwʌts ɪt ˈmeɪd ˈʌv?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's made of silver. It's nine hundred baht.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈmeɪd əv ˈsɪlvər. ɪts ˈnaɪn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's expensive. Do you have earrings?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ðæts ɪkˈspɛnsɪv. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɪrɪŋz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. These earrings are made of silver, too. They're only three hundred baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðiːz ˈɪrɪŋz ər ˈmeɪd əv ˈsɪlvər, ˈtuː. ðɛr ˈoʊnli ˈθriː ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! I'll take them. My friend loves silver jewelry.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! aɪl ˈteɪk ðɛm. maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈlʌvz ˈsɪlvər ˈdʒuːəlri.
